title: Strafe: A new open-source, E2E Encrypted, and federated alternative to Discord
summary: Strafe is a new open-source chat platform designed as a privacy-focused alternative to Discord, featuring end-to-end encryption for secure communications and federated architecture allowing users to host their own servers while maintaining interoperability with other instances.
problem_solved: Addresses privacy concerns and centralization issues by providing a decentralized, encrypted chat platform that doesn't require trusting a single corporation with user data.
why_valuable: It gives users control over their data through E2E encryption while offering the flexibility of federation, similar to how email works, allowing communities to self-host while staying connected.
